product_overview: Al3amer Store is a comprehensive full-stack e-commerce platform tailored for the Egyptian market specializing in POS systems and hardware sales. It offers both public-facing storefront APIs for customers and a robust Admin Dashboard for business management with integrated payment and AI features.
core_goals: Provide seamless product browsing with detailed listings and search capabilities.
Enable secure and flexible user authentication via social login and JWT.
Facilitate smooth order processing including creation, validation, and status tracking.
Integrate Paymob for card and mobile wallet payments with secure webhook callbacks.
Offer a protected Admin Dashboard for analytics, inventory management, and AI-driven product description generation.
Ensure data consistency and synchronization with bulk import features.
Deliver comprehensive error handling and API health for reliability.
key_features: Public Storefront APIs for products, categories, cart, orders, and public settings.
Authentication system supporting social login (Firebase) and secure admin authentication using Bearer tokens.
Payment gateway integration with Paymob supporting multiple payment methods and secure webhook handling.
Admin Dashboard APIs providing sales analytics, inventory import via Excel, AI-generated product descriptions using Gemini, and complete CRUD operations for products, orders, customers, and coupons.
Use of PostgreSQL with Drizzle ORM for robust database management.
Comprehensive backend built with Node.js and Express focusing on API health and business logic correctness.
user_flow_summary: User browses products with filters and views product details via public APIs.
User registers or logs in using social authentication syncing Firebase with backend database.
User places orders capturing accurate subtotal, shipping, and discount calculations, then completes payment via Paymob.
System updates order status asynchronously via secured Paymob webhook callbacks.
Admin logs into the dashboard with bearer token authentication to access reports, manage inventory, and generate AI-assisted product descriptions.
Admin performs bulk inventory updates by importing Excel files through the API endpoints.
validation_criteria: All public GET endpoints must return HTTP 200 OK status.
Invalid API requests with bad or missing IDs should respond with HTTP 400 or 404 appropriately.
Order creation logic must correctly calculate totals including subtotal, shipping costs, and applicable discounts.
Webhook endpoints must validate HMAC signatures to ensure secure updates from Paymob.
Admin routes require proper bearer token validation to restrict access.
Bulk data import must correctly update inventory without data corruption.
AI-generated product descriptions should be relevant and accurately linked to products in the database.
